subject: CSS for indefinite number of textInputs using renderUI and uiOutput

messages.author: e13072fd07a5d80a
messages.subject: CSS for indefinite number of textInputs using renderUI and uiOutput
parts:
Below is a snippet of code I use to generate an indefinite number of textInputs based on n.   Each textInput id is "eShares1", "eShares2", "eShares3"... I want to adjust the width for all textInputs without explicitly referencing each one.  The code below works to adjust the first textInput, but I have been unable to get it to work without explicitly referencing each textInput id.  Thanks!



--ui.R
                 column(2,
                        h5('Current Shares'),
                        uiOutput("editShares_Input"),
                        tags$style(type='text/css', "#eShares1 { width:20px; }")


--Server.R

      output$editShares_Input <- renderUI({

            assetVector <- as.data.frame(getShares1())
            n = nrow(assetVector)
            sharesInput <- vector("list",n)  

            for(i in 1:n){
              sharesInput[[i]] <- list(textInput(inputId = paste0("eShares",i), label = "", value=assetVector[i,1]))
              
            }  
            sharesInput
        })
